notes: The standalone poofout row is LVL_IMMORT at POS_DEAD and reaches SCMD_POOFOUT in the shared setter (R1/R2/R5e).
An empty post-skip-spaces remainder frees the old POOFOUT value, stores NULL, and still emits global OK (R1/R4/R5e).
A non-empty remainder is stored verbatim after C skip_spaces; internal spacing is not token-normalized (R1/R3/R5e).
A custom message with internal spacing receives the exact OK acknowledgement.
The existing home audience matrix owns the shared configured poof-out consumer; this slice owns the standalone setter state (R5b/R5c).
